quarterly_data.signal: Quantum Computing Inc 10-K, fiscal 2025 (in thousands): revenue $682, up 83% from $373 - services $368 ($346) and products $314 ($27) - from hardware products and professional services provided to multiple commercial and government customers under multi-month contracts; product revenue rose on sales of vibrometer and quantum networking devices delivered in 2025, and QCi began recognizing revenue for cloud-based access to its Dirac-3 quantum optimization system. Gross margin was 10% (2024: 30%). Revenue by region: Americas $592, Europe $65, Asia $25.
